description: This file implements the ADOdb Data Dictionary base class for PHP, providing methods for database schema management including table creation, alteration, indexing, and metadata retrieval. It also includes utility functions for parsing SQL fragments and handling database-specific SQL generation.

classes.name: ADODB_DataDict
classes.description: Base class for database schema manipulation, providing methods to create, modify, and analyze database structures across different database systems.

methods.name: metaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables in the connected database.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Obtains index information for a specified table.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL to create a new database.

methods.name: createIndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements to define an index.

methods.name: dropIndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL to drop an index.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL to create a new table with specified fields and options.

methods.name: _genFields
methods.description: Parses field definitions into SQL column definitions and indexes.

methods.name: _getSize
methods.description: Generates size and precision parts of data types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Builds SQL constraints and attributes for a column.

methods.name: _indexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for index creation or dropping.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter an existing table to match new field definitions.
